ph.description: Midpoint between minimum and maximum normalized daily pH indices across monitoring stations.

conductance.description: Normalized electric conductivity representing dissolved mineral ions and salinity.

dissolved_oxygen.description: Normalized dissolved oxygen concentration indicating ecological vitality and aerobic status.

temperature.description: Normalized water temperature influencing oxygen solubility and microbiological growth kinetics.

CPCB_DESIGNATED_BEST_USE.title: Water Quality Criteria for Designated Best Use

classes.A: Drinking Water Source without conventional treatment but after disinfection (pH 6.5–8.5, DO ≥ 6 mg/L, BOD ≤ 2 mg/L)
classes.B: Outdoor bathing organized (pH 6.5–8.5, DO ≥ 5 mg/L, BOD ≤ 3 mg/L)
classes.C: Drinking water source after conventional treatment and disinfection (pH 6.5–8.5, DO ≥ 4 mg/L, BOD ≤ 3 mg/L)
classes.D: Propagation of Wildlife and Fisheries (pH 6.5–8.5, DO ≥ 4 mg/L, Free Ammonia ≤ 1.2 mg/L)
classes.E: Irrigation, Industrial Cooling, Controlled Waste disposal (pH 6.0–8.5, Electrical Conductivity ≤ 2250 µS/cm)

target_definitions.wqi: Horton/Brown Weighted Arithmetic Water Quality Index (0-100)
target_definitions.overall_risk: Multi-state risk: low (WQI>=75), moderate (55-75), high (35-55), critical (<35 or acute deviation)
target_definitions.chemical_hazard: Binary indicator: pH deviation or conductance > 90th percentile
target_definitions.biological_hazard: Binary indicator: DO depletion (<0.40) indicating organic pollution
target_definitions.acute_exceedance: Binary indicator: Any critical chemical or biological failure

train_test_split: Chronological holdout (no lookahead leakage). Quantiles fitted strictly on Train split.
